description: Moving with gentleness and patience allows me to prepare for the gifts that are coming my way. #patience #selflove #selfimprovement
transcript: My life is very calm and peaceful, and everything that I do, I am guided by steadiness. Don't worry about things that are out of my control, and that looks like not trying to control the external world. I don't mind being patient because I am being prepared for the many gifts that are coming my way. There's always a revolving door of gifts, and they come when you are prepared. I don't want anything that I'm not prepared for. I sit in a state of learning. I sit in a state of steadiness.
